en.name: Kitchen Staples
en.subtitle: Everyday grains, dairy and pantry items — and how to keep each one fresh.

zh.name: 廚房常備
zh.subtitle: 穀物、乳蛋與常備食材——逐項保存要訣。

en.name: Bread
en.desc: Sliced loaves and rolls. Toast, sandwich, or French-toast; stales fast at room temperature.
en.tip: Freeze sliced in a sealed bag; toast directly from frozen.

zh.name: 麵包
zh.desc: 吐司與各式麵包。烤土司、做三明治或法式吐司；常溫下易變乾變硬。
zh.tip: 切片密封冷凍；可直接烘烤，免退冰。

en.name: Rice
en.desc: The staple grain. Short-grain for everyday meals; rinse before cooking for fluffier results. One bowl of cooked rice ≈ half a rice-cup of raw rice (75 ml / 50 g).
tip: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dark, dry spot — away from the stove, the sink and strong-smelling foods, and out of sunlight.
To kill weevils, freeze unopened rice for two days, then thaw at room temperature and wipe off any moisture.
Finish the container before topping it up with new rice; rice weevils are harmless even if accidentally eaten.

zh.name: 白米
zh.desc: 主食穀物。日常多用短圓米；煮前淘洗，米飯更鬆軟。一碗飯約等於半杯米（75 毫升／50 克）。
tip: 以密閉容器存放於陰涼、乾燥、避光處——遠離爐具、水槽與氣味強烈的食材，避免陽光照射。
除蟲可將未開封的米冷凍兩天，再置於室溫解凍並擦乾水氣。
容器中的米用完再添新米；米蟲無毒，誤食無害。

en.name: Milk
en.desc: Fresh dairy milk for drinking, cereal and cooking. Keep cold and watch the date.
en.tip: Keep at the back of the fridge, not the door; finish within 5–7 days of opening.

zh.name: 鮮奶
zh.desc: 鮮乳，可直飲、配麥片或入菜。需全程冷藏並留意效期。
zh.tip: 放冷藏內側而非門邊；開封後 5–7 天內喝完。

en.name: Eggs
en.desc: The kitchen all-rounder. Fry, boil, steam (chawanmushi), or bind and batter.
en.tip: Store in the carton, pointed end down; best within 3–4 weeks.

zh.name: 雞蛋
zh.desc: 廚房萬用食材。煎、煮、蒸（茶碗蒸）或作裹粉與黏合皆可。
zh.tip: 連蛋盒尖端朝下冷藏，3–4 週內食用最佳。

en.name: Tofu
en.desc: Soybean curd, soft to firm. Silken for soups, firm for pan-frying, braising and stir-fries.
en.tip: Once opened, submerge in water and change it daily; use within 3 days.

zh.name: 豆腐
zh.desc: 由黃豆製成，質地由嫩到老。嫩豆腐入湯，板豆腐煎、滷、炒皆宜。
zh.tip: 開封後泡水冷藏並每日換水，3 天內食用完。

en.name: Dumplings
en.desc: Pork- or veg-filled wrappers, usually kept frozen. Boil, pan-fry as potstickers, or steam.
en.tip: Freeze on a tray first so they don't clump, then bag; cook straight from frozen.

zh.name: 水餃
zh.desc: 包入豬肉或蔬菜的麵皮，多冷凍保存。可水煮、煎成鍋貼或蒸食。
zh.tip: 先平鋪冷凍定型再裝袋，避免黏在一起；可直接下鍋免解凍。

en.name: Soy sauce
en.desc: The backbone seasoning — salty and savory. For braising, dipping, marinades and stir-fries.
en.tip: Cupboard is fine while sealed; refrigerate after opening.

zh.name: 醬油
zh.desc: 基礎調味料，鹹香甘醇。滷煮、沾醬、醃漬與快炒都少不了。
zh.tip: 未開封可常溫存放；開封後請冷藏。

en.name: Cooking oil
en.desc: Neutral oil for everyday frying and stir-frying. Choose a high smoke point for high heat.
en.tip: Cool, dark place away from the stove; reseal the cap tightly.

zh.name: 食用油
zh.desc: 日常煎炒用的中性油。大火烹調宜選發煙點高的油。
zh.tip: 陰涼避光、遠離爐火，使用後旋緊瓶蓋。
